units.rawText: Arrows clash against claws. Inside the Watchtower, Electra continues battling Alcyone.
units.displayText: Arrows clash against claws. Inside the Watchtower, Electra continues battling Alcyone.

spans.text: Arrows clash against claws. Inside the Watchtower, Electra continues battling Alcyone.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Ahhh~ This feeling takes me back. The feeling of Big Sis Alcyone when you got serious, and the joy of simulated battle.</color>
units.displayText: Ahhh~ This feeling takes me back. The feeling of Big Sis Alcyone when you got serious, and the joy of simulated battle.

spans.text: Ahhh~ This feeling takes me back. The feeling of Big Sis Alcyone when you got serious, and the joy of simulated battle.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>And you're sooooo cute when you get serious, Ally. Hehe, don't worry, I won't let you die.</color>
units.displayText: And you're sooooo cute when you get serious, Ally. Hehe, don't worry, I won't let you die.

spans.text: And you're sooooo cute when you get serious, Ally. Hehe, don't worry, I won't let you die.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Why don't we do it like in the past? If I win, you listen to me. How about that?</color>
units.displayText: Why don't we do it like in the past? If I win, you listen to me. How about that?

spans.text: Why don't we do it like in the past? If I win, you listen to me. How about that?

units.rawText: Alcyone does not answer. The arrows she fires not only keep Electra from advancing, but also wipe out the Entropics advancing on the control terminal.
units.displayText: Alcyone does not answer. The arrows she fires not only keep Electra from advancing, but also wipe out the Entropics advancing on the control terminal.

spans.text: Alcyone does not answer. The arrows she fires not only keep Electra from advancing, but also wipe out the Entropics advancing on the control terminal.

units.rawText: (I might have talked big just now... But Electra really is too hard to handle...)
units.displayText: I might have talked big just now... But Electra really is too hard to handle...

spans.text: I might have talked big just now... But Electra really is too hard to handle...

units.rawText: (Also, she's well-stocked on operands due to being Entropized, and I'm already at the end of my tether...)
units.displayText: Also, she's well-stocked on operands due to being Entropized, and I'm already at the end of my tether...

spans.text: Also, she's well-stocked on operands due to being Entropized, and I'm already at the end of my tether...

units.rawText: Electra, come fight a sim battle with me.
units.displayText: Electra, come fight a sim battle with me.

spans.text: Electra, come fight a sim battle with me.

units.rawText: Hm? That was sudden, Ally.
units.displayText: Hm? That was sudden, Ally.

spans.text: Hm? That was sudden, Ally.

units.rawText: It's too much of a pain—why don't you ask Atlas? I'm seizing every chance I get to slack off.
units.displayText: It's too much of a pain—why don't you ask Atlas? I'm seizing every chance I get to slack off.

spans.text: It's too much of a pain—why don't you ask Atlas? I'm seizing every chance I get to slack off.

units.rawText: ...Because you said I'm not ready yet.
units.displayText: ...Because you said I'm not ready yet.

spans.text: ...Because you said I'm not ready yet.

units.rawText: You'll understand if you fight me. I'll prove that I can enter the battlefield, too!
units.displayText: You'll understand if you fight me. I'll prove that I can enter the battlefield, too!

spans.text: You'll understand if you fight me. I'll prove that I can enter the battlefield, too!

units.rawText: <size=28>...You're exactly the same as you used to be.</size>
units.displayText: ...You're exactly the same as you used to be.

spans.text: ...You're exactly the same as you used to be.

units.rawText: Alright then, since you're asking—
units.displayText: Alright then, since you're asking—

spans.text: Alright then, since you're asking—

units.rawText: (Although you agreed, why did you never go all-out?)
units.displayText: Although you agreed, why did you never go all-out?

spans.text: Although you agreed, why did you never go all-out?

units.rawText: (Now that I think about it... YOU were the one who wasn't prepared, right?)
units.displayText: Now that I think about it... YOU were the one who wasn't prepared, right?

spans.text: Now that I think about it... YOU were the one who wasn't prepared, right?

units.rawText: Aw, I guess I lost to Ally again.
units.displayText: Aw, I guess I lost to Ally again.

spans.text: Aw, I guess I lost to Ally again.

units.rawText: Electra! You had me dead to rights just now, why didn't you strike?
units.displayText: Electra! You had me dead to rights just now, why didn't you strike?

spans.text: Electra! You had me dead to rights just now, why didn't you strike?

units.rawText: But you're so cuuuute, Ally, how could I bear to do it~
units.displayText: But you're so cuuuute, Ally, how could I bear to do it~

spans.text: But you're so cuuuute, Ally, how could I bear to do it~

units.rawText: Quit pinching my face! Listen, we're Greater Sanctifiers. For the sake of Magrasea, we can't slack off, whether it's fighting the Entropics, or patrolling, or in sim battles...
units.displayText: Quit pinching my face! Listen, we're Greater Sanctifiers. For the sake of Magrasea, we can't slack off, whether it's fighting the Entropics, or patrolling, or in sim battles...

spans.text: Quit pinching my face! Listen, we're Greater Sanctifiers. For the sake of Magrasea, we can't slack off, whether it's fighting the Entropics, or patrolling, or in sim battles...

units.rawText: Zzzzzz...
units.displayText: Zzzzzz...

spans.text: Zzzzzz...

units.rawText: LISTEN TO ME!
units.displayText: LISTEN TO ME!

spans.text: LISTEN TO ME!

units.rawText: (You're a Greater Sanctifier, yet you act all ditzy and laid-back, and keep running from practice... What are you afraid of?)
units.displayText: You're a Greater Sanctifier, yet you act all ditzy and laid-back, and keep running from practice... What are you afraid of?

spans.text: You're a Greater Sanctifier, yet you act all ditzy and laid-back, and keep running from practice... What are you afraid of?

units.rawText: Alcyone evades Electra's claws with great effort, then fires a golden arrow as a parting shot. However, Electra easily parries it.
units.displayText: Alcyone evades Electra's claws with great effort, then fires a golden arrow as a parting shot. However, Electra easily parries it.

spans.text: Alcyone evades Electra's claws with great effort, then fires a golden arrow as a parting shot. However, Electra easily parries it.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Hehe, that's Big Sis Alcyone's trademark retreating shot... You know, I'm much more familiar with that move than you are.</color>
units.displayText: Hehe, that's Big Sis Alcyone's trademark retreating shot... You know, I'm much more familiar with that move than you are.

spans.text: Hehe, that's Big Sis Alcyone's trademark retreating shot... You know, I'm much more familiar with that move than you are.

units.rawText: Electra! Today's practice... Hm? Electra? Where is she?
units.displayText: Electra! Today's practice... Hm? Electra? Where is she?

spans.text: Electra! Today's practice... Hm? Electra? Where is she?

units.rawText: Zzzzzzzzzzzzz...
units.displayText: Zzzzzzzzzzzzz...

spans.text: Zzzzzzzzzzzzz...

units.rawText: Get up! You koala!
units.displayText: Get up! You koala!

spans.text: Get up! You koala!

units.rawText: Zzz... Huh? Is that you, Ally? Did you smell the chocolate I made?
units.displayText: Zzz... Huh? Is that you, Ally? Did you smell the chocolate I made?

spans.text: Zzz... Huh? Is that you, Ally? Did you smell the chocolate I made?

units.rawText: What's that? Uwah... It's so sweet that it's making me shudder, what's with that...
units.displayText: What's that? Uwah... It's so sweet that it's making me shudder, what's with that...

spans.text: What's that? Uwah... It's so sweet that it's making me shudder, what's with that...

units.rawText: This is the snack that I spent all night and all my effort making for you, Ally.
units.displayText: This is the snack that I spent all night and all my effort making for you, Ally.

spans.text: This is the snack that I spent all night and all my effort making for you, Ally.

units.rawText: What the heck is this... Wait, you spent all night on it? Was that why you were late for morning practice?!
units.displayText: What the heck is this... Wait, you spent all night on it? Was that why you were late for morning practice?!

spans.text: What the heck is this... Wait, you spent all night on it? Was that why you were late for morning practice?!

units.rawText: Today's morning practice? Ah, it was the special class for retreating shots, right? I mastered that in the sims long ago, it'll be fine even if I miss it.
units.displayText: Today's morning practice? Ah, it was the special class for retreating shots, right? I mastered that in the sims long ago, it'll be fine even if I miss it.

spans.text: Today's morning practice? Ah, it was the special class for retreating shots, right? I mastered that in the sims long ago, it'll be fine even if I miss it.

units.rawText: Quit making excuses, I never used it before in my sim battles with you!
units.displayText: Quit making excuses, I never used it before in my sim battles with you!

spans.text: Quit making excuses, I never used it before in my sim battles with you!

units.rawText: Ah... Hahaha, I'm sure you'll be able to make good use of the retreating shot. I need to get close to defeat it!
units.displayText: Ah... Hahaha, I'm sure you'll be able to make good use of the retreating shot. I need to get close to defeat it!

spans.text: Ah... Hahaha, I'm sure you'll be able to make good use of the retreating shot. I need to get close to defeat it!

units.rawText: Then I'll just need to think of a way to keep you from getting close. I should give it a try next time... Hey wait, don't try to run away!
units.displayText: Then I'll just need to think of a way to keep you from getting close. I should give it a try next time... Hey wait, don't try to run away!

spans.text: Then I'll just need to think of a way to keep you from getting close. I should give it a try next time... Hey wait, don't try to run away!

units.rawText: (Thanks to you, I figured out how to win.)
units.displayText: Thanks to you, I figured out how to win.

spans.text: Thanks to you, I figured out how to win.

units.rawText: <size=40>JUDGEMENT ARROW!</size>
units.displayText: JUDGEMENT ARROW!

spans.text: JUDGEMENT ARROW!

units.rawText: Alcyone grits her teeth as she weathers Electra's onslaught, then uses a blind spot in the terrain to fire off a shot. However, Electra seems to have read her every movement.
units.displayText: Alcyone grits her teeth as she weathers Electra's onslaught, then uses a blind spot in the terrain to fire off a shot. However, Electra seems to have read her every movement.

spans.text: Alcyone grits her teeth as she weathers Electra's onslaught, then uses a blind spot in the terrain to fire off a shot. However, Electra seems to have read her every movement.

units.rawText: Her arrows are no good against Electra. She knows their trajectory, their timing, everything about them.
units.displayText: Her arrows are no good against Electra. She knows their trajectory, their timing, everything about them.

spans.text: Her arrows are no good against Electra. She knows their trajectory, their timing, everything about them.

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>Hahaha, that's the way. It's been so long since I could go all-out when fighting you.</color>
units.displayText: Hahaha, that's the way. It's been so long since I could go all-out when fighting you.

spans.text: Hahaha, that's the way. It's been so long since I could go all-out when fighting you.

units.rawText: ...This is it...
units.displayText: ...This is it...

spans.text: ...This is it...

units.rawText: Her sharp claws shred the edges of Alcyone's clothes. Alcyone pulls out an arrow and barely manages to block Electra's attack.
units.displayText: Her sharp claws shred the edges of Alcyone's clothes. Alcyone pulls out an arrow and barely manages to block Electra's attack.

spans.text: Her sharp claws shred the edges of Alcyone's clothes. Alcyone pulls out an arrow and barely manages to block Electra's attack.

units.rawText: (Pants heavily)
units.displayText: Pants heavily

spans.text: Pants heavily

units.rawText: Alcyone's labored breathing indicates that her operand levels are at their limit. But at this moment, the two of them are closer than ever before.
units.displayText: Alcyone's labored breathing indicates that her operand levels are at their limit. But at this moment, the two of them are closer than ever before.

spans.text: Alcyone's labored breathing indicates that her operand levels are at their limit. But at this moment, the two of them are closer than ever before.

units.rawText: As she looks at the familiar face that's almost touching hers, Alcyone smiles.
units.displayText: As she looks at the familiar face that's almost touching hers, Alcyone smiles.

spans.text: As she looks at the familiar face that's almost touching hers, Alcyone smiles.

units.rawText: You're finally looking at me, Electra.
units.displayText: You're finally looking at me, Electra.

spans.text: You're finally looking at me, Electra.

units.rawText: Electra jabs at Alcyone. Alcyone does not dodge, but moves into the blow.
units.displayText: Electra jabs at Alcyone. Alcyone does not dodge, but moves into the blow.

spans.text: Electra jabs at Alcyone. Alcyone does not dodge, but moves into the blow.

units.rawText: Electra's claws pierce her petite body.
units.displayText: Electra's claws pierce her petite body.

spans.text: Electra's claws pierce her petite body.

units.rawText: Ugh...
units.displayText: Ugh...

spans.text: Ugh...

units.rawText: <color=#A066D3>?!</color>
In response, Alcyone extends her arms and grabs Electra by the throat.
units.displayText: In response, Alcyone extends her arms and grabs Electra by the throat.

spans.text: In response, Alcyone extends her arms and grabs Electra by the throat.

units.rawText: <size=40>BEGIN HACK!</size>
units.displayText: BEGIN HACK!

spans.text: BEGIN HACK!

units.rawText: <color=red><size=60>GWAAAAAAARGH!</size></color>
units.displayText: GWAAAAAAARGH!

spans.text: GWAAAAAAARGH!

units.rawText: Unlike the expected hack, the traces of Entropization on Electra instead counter-hack Alcyone.
units.displayText: Unlike the expected hack, the traces of Entropization on Electra instead counter-hack Alcyone.

spans.text: Unlike the expected hack, the traces of Entropization on Electra instead counter-hack Alcyone.

units.rawText: I can do it...! This is going to work!
units.displayText: I can do it...! This is going to work!

spans.text: I can do it...! This is going to work!
